content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent riding was **two sessions totaling 3.5 hours and 140 Load**. Current **Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, Form +7**, with stable resting HR/HRV and roughly 7.5 hours’ sleep, so you look fresh enough for one longer aerobic ride plus one controlled quality session.

### Saturday — Endurance, 1h45
Warmup: 10min progressively from 50–65% FTP  
Main: 85min Z2 at 60–72% FTP, comfortable conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated intensity: ~0.67  
Estimated Load: 75–85  
Why: Builds aerobic volume without creating excessive fatigue.

### Sunday — Sweet spot, 1h10
Warmup: 15min from 50–70% FTP  
Main: 3×10min at 88–92% FTP, 5min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated intensity: ~0.78  
Estimated Load: 55–65  
Why: Adds productive sustained work while your form is positive.

If Saturday leaves your legs unusually heavy, replace Sunday’s sweet spot with 45–60min easy Z2. Estimated weekend total: **130–150 Load**.
